title: Loi sur les normes du travail (Act respecting labour standards)
verified_how: NOT verified against the register: www.legisquebec.gouv.qc.ca refused every request with HTTP 403 from Amazon CloudFront ('Request blocked'), so neither the register's own title page nor its 'a jour au' date could be read. The French title and RLRQ chapter number recorded here are corroborated only by LegisQuebec page titles and PDF headings that appeared in web-search results (e.g. 'chapitre N-1.1 LOI SUR LES NORMES DU TRAVAIL'), which is not a substitute for the register.
notes: Quebec's minimum labour standards - wages, pay periods, minimum wage, hours of work and overtime - administered by the CNESST. The minimum wage rate itself is set by the Reglement sur les normes du travail, RLRQ c. N-1.1, r. 3.
